statuses.imputed: excluded from fitting; API returns status, no distribution
statuses.flag: fitted and returned with the flag attached
statuses.bottom_coded: reported at the lower reporting limit: open interval below
statuses.top_coded: reported at the upper reporting limit: open interval above

rules.note: 14 also have an imputed op end

rules.test: offset from the device reference outside the model grid
rules.note: Excluded from the anaesthesia-end fit and returned as invalid: out of range, not corrected. Anaesthesia end is 720 min after recording end in case 3980 and 1,441 min after it in case 4959; a 12-hour clock slip or a one-day date error are candidate explanations, neither confirmed. The October 2026 fit had included both at clipped probability (a constant), so its parameters were unaffected; its fit block is now re-evaluated without them.

rules.test: sub-minute offset differs from anaesthesia start's (charted times should share it)
value consistent with mL rather than units
no other lab panel at the same timestamp
kidney transplant, donor or other nephrectomy

rules.note: A true zero: renal failure or dialysis (preoperative creatinine > 2 mg/dL, 8 cases) or an organ donor (ASA 6, 1 case). Returned as a point mass at 0 (zero_model in intraop_uo.model.json).

Normal creatinine; zero over 2-3 h is unlikely, so a blocked catheter or a 0 meaning not measured are possible. Kept and returned like an anuric zero, but flagged so analyses treating urine output as a measurement can drop it.

rules.test: either time missing or invalid, aneend derived from an imputed op end, or aneend outside the model range
rules.note: Volume models with a duration covariate (urine output, crystalloid, blood loss) then use the latent averaged over the fitted cases' durations.

rules.test: icu_days > 0 and icu_days >= (dis - case-day midnight) / 86400 (adm and dis are midnights)
rules.note: ICU days at least the days from the case-day midnight to the discharge midnight: the count probably includes preoperative ICU days (24 of 36 are emergencies). Do not use as postoperative ICU length. Includes the 6 order_violation cases. The atlas handover counted 37; this definition gives 36.
Reporting limit: values above 15 mmol/L are reported as 15.0 (at most 16 results at any nearby value). Open interval: at least 15.
Reporting limit 400.0 s (clot not formed in range); preop_aptt has 2 such values. Open interval: at least 400.
Reporting floor 2 mm/h: no result below it. Open interval: at most 2.

case_ids: may appear where a specific case is discussed (as here); bulk per-case lists stay with the analysis outputs
